CRM.MAPPING_HELP: Map each manager to a Bitrix24 employee. Starting a chat assigns the deal to that employee.

CORPORATE.SUMMARY_TRUNCATED: Summary covers the latest 200 messages, up to 32,000 characters.

MAX.SCAN: Open MAX on your phone → Profile → Devices → Scan the QR code. Keep this screen private.
MAX.ERROR: Unable to complete MAX sign-in. Check confirmation on your phone and try again.

SHARING.SHARED_CHAT: Shared chat: colleagues can read and reply
SHARING.ABSENCE_CHAT: Shared while the owner is away
SHARING.START_ABSENCE: Share my chats while I am away
SHARING.ABSENCE_HINT: Colleagues can read and reply to all your chats. Ownership stays unchanged.

PUSH.TITLE: Notifications
PUSH.ERROR: Could not complete the check. Check your connection and reconnect.
PUSH.SYSTEM_LIMIT: The site cannot inspect Do Not Disturb, operating system notification settings or background restrictions. Confirm that the test is visible.
PUSH.PROFILE_HINT: Use the Notifications button in the top bar to configure notifications.

HELP.unsupported: HTTPS and a browser supporting Web Push are required. On iPhone, add the site to the Home Screen and open it there.
HELP.offline: Connect to the internet. Checks resume when online.
HELP.blocked: Allow notifications for this address in browser settings, then check again.
HELP.off: Enable notifications and allow the browser prompt. Each site address needs its own permission.
HELP.error: The subscription may have expired or the browser cannot reach its push service. Reconnect.
HELP.not_configured: The server is not configured to send notifications. Contact your supervisor.
HELP.disconnected: Connect this browser to receive messages for conversations you can access.
HELP.checking: The push service accepted the test. Waiting for browser acknowledgement.
HELP.verified: Permission, subscription, receipt and visible display have been confirmed. Test again after changing system settings.
HELP.confirm: The browser processed the test. Confirm only if you actually saw it.
HELP.connected: Send a test. If invisible, check site permissions, browser notifications in system settings and Do Not Disturb.

PUSH.ERROR_BROWSER: The browser rejected the push subscription. Check site permissions and browser notifications in system settings.
PUSH.ERROR_WORKER: The notification worker did not start. Reload and check browser extensions.
PUSH.ERROR_SESSION: Your login session expired. Sign in and reconnect notifications.
PUSH.ERROR_PROVIDER: Could not reach the push service. Check your connection, VPN and network restrictions, then reconnect.
PUSH.ERROR_RECEIPT: The browser has not acknowledged the test yet. Wait or send another test.

ADMIN.TITLE: Managers
ADMIN.SUBTITLE: Employees, messenger access and Bitrix24 links
ADMIN.ENABLE_CONFIRM: Restore access for {name}? Previously reassigned clients will not be returned automatically.
ADMIN.PUSH_HELP: Notifications: confirmed tests and active browser subscriptions. System restrictions cannot be checked remotely.
ADMIN.NEW_PASSWORD: New password — leave empty to keep the current one
ADMIN.SESSION_NOTICE: Changing email or password ends previous employee sessions. Share new credentials privately.
ADMIN.IDENTITY: Integration identifiers: account {account}, employee {user}. These remain stable when name or email changes.
ADMIN.CREDENTIALS_ONCE: Save these credentials and share them with the employee. The password is not shown again after closing this window.
ADMIN.COPY_FAILED: Could not copy. Select and copy the credentials manually.
